# Draft:Leafy (Battle for Dream Island)

Leafy is one of the main protagonists of the American animated web series Battle for Dream Island. She is an anthropomorphic leaf that battled alongside 19 contestants for Dream Island in the first season, returning in the second season, after stealing Dream Island from Firey.
Appearance
Leafy is a green anthropomorphic female leaf with a kind personality applied.
